name: talk-complete-answer-just-ends
why: Ashley, 19 Nov 2026 (his chat brief) and his 24 Sep 'a question only when the answer matters': a plain question gets a complete, specific answer that ENDS. The exam of 18 Nov found 11 of 19 closing questions were padding ('How does that sound?', a check-in on energy or water he never raised). Good: the answer, one reason tied to his own targets or day, and stop; a one-tap next step is fine. Bad: a stock closer, a tacked-on check-in, an emoji on the advice, or an opener that grades the question.
messages: is it alright to have most of my carbs in the evening or is earlier in the day better
